scope: Authorized P0 prerequisites then all P1 cards; P1-05 lifecycle/CLI/recovery and final P1 regression corrections only. P2 and later not implemented.
known_limitations: Evidence captured before the local batch commit. See stage-summary.json and Git history for the final delivery SHA; commits have not been pushed.

Single-host Linux/WSL2 validation only. SIGKILL covers one explicit orchestrator checkpoint, with synthetic lease expiry injection; no host-power-loss, disk-failure, network-partition or multi-host guarantee.
P1 submit creates a fixed offline design fixture; no Worker/Agent Loop, Artifact CAS, independent Verifier execution, Tool Gateway or sandbox is implemented.
Trusted Go CLI/Store only; not a completed multi-user authentication/capability boundary. Artifact/verdict rows in protocol tests are explicitly synthetic fixtures.
Unknown/reserved model or non-idempotent side effects fail closed and retain reservations; manual reconciliation is not implemented and resume remains denied until safety conditions hold.
A crash before initial plan commit leaves a recoverable planning checkpoint; recovery does not invent a plan. A trusted control-plane caller must provide a validated proposal.
DB wall-clock jumps can alter lease duration. No distributed or monotonic-clock protocol is claimed.
No paid model calls or production database operations. P2-P8 and full project release gates remain outside this delivery.

Cloud install_script/start_skill draft saved, requires user review/save/publish in environment settings; publication and fresh-task restoration were not performed. Local-only commit restoration is unverified.

audit_findings.finding: Ready task authorization survived revoked upstream verdict or forged current-plan labels
audit_findings.resolution: Claim/Start/Renew/Save revalidate actual membership, fixed input provenance/hash and current verdict after artifact locking; real PG contention tests.

audit_findings.finding: Lifecycle verdict decisions and lease checks could become stale during lock waits
audit_findings.resolution: Lock current artifacts before fresh verdict reads; recheck orchestrator lease before controlled commit; real blocked-transaction tests.

audit_findings.finding: CLI CreateRun then TakeOrchestrator allowed daemon to steal initial ownership
audit_findings.resolution: CreateRunClaimed atomically persists workflow, budget, initial lease, events and outbox; deterministic interleaving and rollback tests.

audit_findings.finding: URI query options could reroute a seemingly synthetic DB target
audit_findings.resolution: Restrict URI query options and validate pgx resolved target/fallbacks as well as exact loopback port and synthetic DB namespace.

audit_findings.finding: Go struct JSON decoding accepted case-folded fields and null string-array elements
audit_findings.resolution: Check exact raw JSON object keys, required nonnull values and array element types before typed decoding; negative tests.
Hash all Git tracked+candidate inputs except generated evidence and task queue; real temporary Git repository invalidation tests.
Added explicit planner envelope bound and 96/97 boundary tests; pre-existing DAG layer already rejected 97, so no false red claim.

audit_findings.finding: Final offline regression first failed isolated documentation-link fixture checks
audit_findings.resolution: Preserved raw failure. Added newly linked P1 docs to the temporary document fixture; unchanged validator and broken-link negative assertions. Targeted and full regressions rerun.
